name: WhatsApp Outbound - Le Toit des Anges

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', recipient_type: 'individual', to: $json.to, type: 'template', template: { name: $json.template.name, language: { code: $json.template.language }, components: $json.template.components } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', recipient_type: 'individual', to: $json.to, type: 'text', text: { preview_url: true, body: $json.message } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', recipient_type: 'individual', to: $json.to, type: 'document', document: $json.document.mediaId ? { id: $json.document.mediaId, filename: $json.document.filename, caption: $json.document.caption } : { link: $json.document.url, filename: $json.document.filename, caption: $json.document.caption } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ type: 'outbound_request', source: 'gestockpro', userPhone: $json.toE164, templateName: $json.template.name, templateLanguage: $json.template.language, templateVariables: $json.template.variables, message: $json.message, category: $json.category, reference: $json.reference, documentUrl: $json.document ? $json.document.url : null, documentFilename: $json.document ? $json.document.filename : null }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ type: 'system_message_sent', source: 'gestockpro', userPhone: $json.to, category: $json.category, reference: $json.reference, summary: $('Boucle destinataires').first().json.message, documentFilename: $json.documentFilename, messageId: $json.messageId, sentAt: $json.sentAt }) }}
